name: Folate (Vitamin B9)
summary: A water-soluble vitamin essential for one-carbon metabolism, DNA/RNA synthesis and red-cell production; critical in early pregnancy for neural tube closure.

conditions.label: Deficiency
conditions.description: Impairs DNA synthesis (megaloblastic anaemia) and, in early pregnancy, neural tube closure in the fetus.

affects.detail: Like B12 deficiency, impaired DNA synthesis enlarges red cells; unlike B12, folate deficiency does not cause neurological demyelination.

affects.effect: Fetal neural tube defects (spina bifida, anencephaly)
affects.detail: Deficiency around conception raises the risk of failed neural tube closure in the embryo.

genderModifiers.female: People who could become pregnant are advised to take ~400 micrograms of folic acid daily before and in early pregnancy to cut neural tube defect risk.

affects.effect: Defective neural tube / spinal cord formation (fetal)
affects.detail: The neural tube forms the brain and spinal cord; incomplete closure in the first month of gestation produces structural CNS defects.

references.title: Folic acid for the prevention of neural tube defects
